conditions.name: API - Erros 5xx
conditions.description: Respostas 5xx da API em producao (sem probes de health).
conditions.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND httpResponseCode >= 500 AND request.uri NOT IN ('/livez', '/healthz', '/alive', '/health')

conditions.name: API - Login lento (p95)
conditions.description: p95 de login, contexto de login e renovacao de sessao acima de 3 s.
conditions.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri IN ('/api/users/authenticate', '/api/users/login-context', '/api/session/renovar', '/api/session/restaurar')

conditions.name: Banco - Indisponivel (503)
conditions.description: Respostas 503 sustentadas (database_unavailable). O resume do SQL serverless gera poucas; volume alto e falha real.
conditions.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND httpResponseCode = 503

conditions.name: Functions e filas - Falha de integracao
conditions.description: Erros da API ao publicar em fila ou chamar Azure Functions (Storage/reset). A execucao dentro da Function nao e observavel no New Relic.
conditions.query: SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND error.class IN ('Azure.RequestFailedException', 'System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException', 'System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException')

conditions.name: Front - Erros JavaScript
conditions.description: Erros JavaScript do hemodinks-front (New Relic Browser, front #262).
conditions.query: SELECT count(*) FROM JavaScriptError WHERE appName = '{{BROWSER_APP}}'
